# Phase Implementation PR

> **Branch naming**: `revamp/p{phase}-{slug}` (e.g., `revamp/p04-networking`)  
> **PR title**: `Revamp: Phase {phase} — {short topic}`

## 📋 Phase Scope

### Phase and Modules
- **Phase**: [Phase Number] - [Phase Name]
- **Modules**: List modules being implemented
- **Progress Anchors**: List all anchors being added (e.g., p04-m01-l01, p04-m01-l02)

### Learning Objectives
- [ ] Objective 1: [Describe what learners will accomplish]
- [ ] Objective 2: [Describe practical skills gained]
- [ ] Objective 3: [Describe conceptual understanding developed]

## 📚 Content Implementation

### Required Files
- [ ] `README.md` - Concept map and overview completed
- [ ] `lab.md` - Hands-on exercises implemented
- [ ] `verify.rules.md` - Verification procedures created
- [ ] `cleanup.rules.md` - Cleanup procedures documented
- [ ] `visuals.md` - Visual aids planned and specified

### Micro-lessons Implemented
- [ ] **Micro-lesson 1**: [Name] (`[anchor]`) - [Brief description]
- [ ] **Micro-lesson 2**: [Name] (`[anchor]`) - [Brief description]
- [ ] **Micro-lesson 3**: [Name] (`[anchor]`) - [Brief description]
- [ ] **Micro-lesson 4**: [Name] (`[anchor]`) - [Brief description]

*Note: Minimum 3 micro-lessons required per phase*

- [ ] **Exercise 3**: [Name] - [What it teaches]

- [ ] All exercises have clear success indicators

## ⚠️ Production Notes and Pitfalls

### Production Relevance

## 🔗 Integration and References

### Progress Tracking
- [ ] All progress anchors added to `/docs/PROGRESS.json`
- [ ] Phase status updated to "implemented"
- [ ] Lesson completion percentages updated

### Cross-references
- [ ] Links to relevant phases work correctly
- [ ] Glossary terms referenced appropriately
- [ ] FAQ entries updated if needed
- [ ] Platform notes referenced where relevant

### Dependencies
- [ ] Prerequisites from earlier phases clearly stated
- [ ] Forward references to later phases appropriate
- [ ] No circular dependencies created

## 🧪 Quality Assurance

### Content Standards
- [ ] Scannable format used (bullets > paragraphs)
- [ ] Active voice throughout
- [ ] Clear, actionable instructions
- [ ] Consistent terminology with glossary

### Technical Accuracy
- [ ] All commands tested and verified
- [ ] Docker best practices followed
- [ ] Security considerations addressed
- [ ] No deprecated or discouraged patterns

### Educational Effectiveness
- [ ] Progressive complexity maintained
- [ ] Immediate feedback mechanisms included
- [ ] Clear success/failure indicators
- [ ] Reflection prompts included where appropriate

### Explicitly Not Included
- [ ] [Feature/concept] - Reason: [Will be covered in Phase X]

### Future Considerations

## 📋 Reviewer Checklist (for maintainers)

### Content Review
- [ ] All learning objectives clearly stated and achievable
- [ ] Hands-on exercises provide immediate value
- [ ] Production relevance clearly demonstrated
- [ ] Common pitfalls well-documented

### Technical Review
- [ ] All commands execute correctly
- [ ] Docker best practices followed consistently
- [ ] Security considerations appropriate
- [ ] Platform differences properly addressed

### Educational Review
- [ ] Progressive difficulty maintained
- [ ] Clear success indicators provided
- [ ] Accessibility considerations met
- [ ] Consistent with curriculum standards

### Structure Review
- [ ] All required files present and complete
- [ ] Progress tracking updated correctly
- [ ] Cross-references functional
- [ ] Visual aids appropriate and planned
